name: Drum Bus Image
description: The kick and the snare kept in the middle, the cymbals and the room as wide as the overheads gave them, a little wider at the top.

name: Narrow Guitars
description: A pair of guitars drawn in so they leave room at the edges for the rest, their top left as it was.

name: Stereo Repair
description: For a recording whose lows go out of phase between the sides: below 250 Hz made mono, the rest a little narrower.

name: Wide Pads
description: Pads and keys spread wide above the low middle, their lows kept narrow so they do not muddy the middle.

name: Focused Middle
description: The low middle drawn in toward the middle, where the voice and the snare live, and the top left wide: more focus, the same space.

name: Mono Check
description: Everything mono, for listening to how a mix holds up on one speaker; switch it off again before export.

name: Mono Lows
description: What every master wants and nothing else: the lows in mono below 120 Hz, so a kick and a bass sit in the middle and a club's system and a vinyl cut take them, everything above as it came.

name: Wider Top
description: The top opened a little and the upper middle a touch, the lows mono: a master that breathes wider without its middle going hollow.
